zip_contents.primary_header_issue: The primary CSV header begins longitude:string,latitude:string,Label:string, but its first data row begins APC001,240.4585,-0.94678, so header/row field order is inconsistent.

regional_filter.longitude_convention: Catalog longitudes are 0–360 degrees east; filter used that convention directly.
regional_filter.result_interpretation: Zero actual catalog candidates in the selected region. The empty subset is not caused by an invalid CSV parse: the companion CSV has explicit longitude/latitude columns and all 1,062 rows have valid coordinates.

catalog_semantics: Catalog features are orbital-image-derived candidate cave entrances; they are not confirmed accessible, safe, or usable shelters.

quality_notes.selected_source: miscellaneous/Mars_Cave_Catalog_shapefile.csv, because its header and row values unambiguously pair longitude then latitude.
quality_notes.primary_source_handling: Did not use data/Mars_Cave_Catalog.csv for geographic filtering because its header order disagrees with its rows.
quality_notes.coordinate_checks: Every companion record parsed to finite-range numeric longitude and latitude; no invalid coordinate rows.
